model.title: Canterbury Shaker Village National Heritage Area Study Authorization Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Maggie Hassan (D-NH)

summary.text: The bill would authorize the Secretary of the Interior to study whether the Canterbury Shaker Village area in New Hampshire is suitable for designation as a National Heritage Area, which would recognize its historical and cultural significance and could help preserve and promote the site.
